derivation.repair: The Display rear shell was authored with per-triangle flat normals. V4 replaces only that shell's NORMAL accessor with area-weighted normals averaged across coincident shell vertices, then adjusts its graphite polymer to metallic 0.04 and roughness 0.56. No shell positions, indices, UVs, node transforms, screen geometry, or other mesh/material records changed.
derivation.runtime: Python standard library; deterministic and offline

geometry.screen_active_area_basis: 7-inch class diagonal and 1024:600 aspect ratio; estimated, not measured

comparison_reference.use: Comparison context only; not product CAD or manufacturer identity.

qualification_limits: V4 is an asset-only repair; its native Device Studio appearance has not yet been reviewed.
The authored envelope and active screen area are not measurements of a Google product or physical unit.
The tabletop support pose is candidate geometry, not stability proof or product qualification.
